purpose: One-shot 380-780 nm original-SQM closure test using independently retrieved CAMS total-aerosol vertical extinction shape, with no Taylor-based fitting.

baselineAnalysis.use: reuse frozen Vega SQM zero point and original comparison only

aod.center: per-row aod550_primary_frozen from the original Taylor atmosphere freeze
aod.localSensitivity: center-minus-sigma and center-plus-sigma, all 32 rows; no fitting

sqm.spectralResponse: frozen TSL237S+HOYA CM-500 combined response with angle-dependent CM500 correction
